One-call analysis report

Source: R/report.R
irt_report.Rd

Writes a complete, self-contained HTML report of a fitted model: overview and model fit, item parameters, reliability, item fit (infit/outfit and S-X2), local dependence, dimensionality, Wright map, item and test curves, summed-score conversion table and, when a grouping variable is given, an IRT-based DIF analysis. For many-facet models the report follows the FACETS layout: facet summary, a measurement table per facet, rating scale statistics, the variable map, fit, bias/interaction analysis and unexpected responses. Every table and figure in the report can also be produced on its own with the functions it names.

Usage

irt_report(
  x,
  file = "IRTistic-report.html",
  title = NULL,
  author = NULL,
  group = NULL,
  open = interactive()
)

Arguments

x

An `irtfit` or `mfrmfit`.

file

Output HTML file.

title, author

Report title and author.

group

Optional grouping vector for a DIF section (`irtfit` only).

open

Open the report in a browser when done.

Value

The path to the report, invisibly.

Details

Requires the 'rmarkdown' and 'knitr' packages (and pandoc, which ships with RStudio).

Examples

if (FALSE) {
fit <- irt_fit(sim_irt(500, 12, "2pl"), "2pl")
irt_report(fit, "my-analysis.html", group = rep(c("A", "B"), 250))
}
